name: A.F.P. Fane
features: olive skin, dark hair swept back, dark eyes, lean angular face, high cheekbones, slim wiry build, intense focused expression
bio: Born Alfred Fane Peers Agabeg to an Armenian mining family in India and renamed by deed poll in 1931. He was AFN’s chief salesman, a shareholder and by some way its fastest driver: with his Frazer Nash TT Replica he was close to unbeatable at Brooklands, Shelsley Walsh, Prescott and Lewes, and he raced BMWs at the Nürburgring, the Mille Miglia and Le Mans. He joined the RAF a week after war was declared, photographed the Tirpitz from a Spitfire in January 1942, and was lost in bad weather that July.
